caption: The drawing depicts a single black heeled shoe shown in profile, occupying the central and lower part of the composition. The shoe has a pointed toe, a low-cut upper, and a moderately high, curved heel. The interior edge of the shoe appears to have a lighter beige or cream lining. Above and to the left of the shoe, there are two small outline sketches showing the shoe from different top-down perspectives, both rendered in fine black lines without coloring. The background is a plain, off-white or light beige color. The artist's name, "MAE SZILVASY," is written in the lower right corner of the page.
title: Shoe
